Title : Director - Regional CMC

Location : Brazil, Remote

Experience : Min 15 years in Regulatory Affairs, CMC

Director – Regional CMC

Objective:

The Director – Regional CMC will manage the Regional CMC team, ensuring seamless integration between global Regulatory CMC strategies and local affiliate execution. This role is pivotal in driving regional alignment, efficiency, and consistency in post-approval submissions across a diverse product portfolio, including small molecules, biologics, vaccines, and plasma-derived therapies. The Director – Regional CMC will champion the development and implementation of regional strategies, fostering collaboration and process improvement to meet regulatory requirements effectively and efficiently.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Oversee and manage the Regional CMC team, providing guidance, training, and support to ensure high performance and professional development.
  • Foster a collaborative and inclusive team environment, promoting knowledge sharing and best practices.
  • Develop and execute a strategic vision for the Regional CMC Liaison function, aligning with global Regulatory CMC objectives.
  • Ensure the team is equipped with the necessary skills, knowledge, and resources to excel in their roles.
  • Translate global CMC strategies into comprehensive regional plans, ensuring alignment with country-specific regulatory requirements.
  • Oversee the development and implementation of regional submission strategies to streamline processes and reduce duplication of effort.
  • Partner with global and regional stakeholders to identify opportunities for harmonization and efficiency.
  • Monitor and report on submission timelines and regulatory approvals, addressing any issues or delays proactively.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with local affiliates to understand and address country-specific regulatory needs and challenges.
  • Liaise with global Regulatory CMC teams to provide regional insights and feedback, ensuring a cohesive approach to regulatory submissions.
  • Represent the Regional CMC Liaison function in cross-functional and global meetings, advocating for regional needs and perspectives.
  • Identify and address bottlenecks in the regional submission process, proposing and implementing innovative solutions to enhance efficiency.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives, leveraging best practices and lessons learned to optimize regional submission processes.
  • Ensure compliance with regional and country-specific regulatory requirements and guidelines.

Education & Competencies (Technical and Behavioral):

  • BS/BA Degree in a Scientific Discipline, Advanced Degree (M.S), with Ph.D. preferred.
  • 15+ years of seasoned biopharmaceutical/device industry experience or with a regulatory agency is preferred, while leading major submissions during LCM, development - including preparation of NDA/NLA/MAA.
  • Equivalent industry experience with direct technical/product development experience such as Pharmaceutical Development, Analytical Development, Production, Quality Assurance can be considered.
  • People leadership experience (5+ years) required.
  • Highly proficient understanding of scientific principles and profound grasp of global regulatory CMC requirements relevant to global drug development and post-market support.
  • Keeping abreast of industry insights and regulatory trends to drive organizational evolution.
  • Proven ability to understand and communicate regulatory strategy to drug development, registration, and post-market support teams.
  • Analyze issues with attention to detail.
  • Ability to assess and scientifically justify alternative approaches.
  • Base regulatory strategy recommendations on precedents and other regulatory intelligence as well as regulations and guidelines.
  • Able to deal with issues of critical importance independently.
  • Exercises excellent judgment in elevating and communicating actual or potential issues to line management.
  • Understands who is responsible for different decisions, drives and escalates as necessary.
  • Implements the directions taken by the company, leading with agility through evolving landscapes.
  • Intentionally promotes an inclusive culture, leveraging individual strengths for team success.
  • Develops and drives prioritization framework, managing shifting priorities and tight deadlines.
  • Exceptional skills in written and oral communication.

Você será responsável por transformar dados em inteligência de mercado, criando algoritmos, análises e soluções que melhorem conversão, previsão, personalização e tomada de decisão.

  • Criar, treinar e manter modelos de machine learning (supervisionados e não supervisionados).

  • Transformar grandes volumes de dados estruturados e não estruturados em insights acionáveis.
  • Garantir documentação, versionamento, qualidade e reprodutibilidade dos modelos.
  • Criar métricas de avaliação, monitoramento e indicadores de impacto.

  • Experiência sólida com Python (pandas, numpy, sklearn, PyTorch ou TensorFlow).
  • SQL avançado;
  • Experiência comprovada com machine learning aplicado a problemas reais.
  • Pamiliaridade com processos ETL/ELT e orquestração de dados.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de versionamento e boas práticas de engenharia.

The Legal Operations Specialist supports the legal department by driving operational efficiency, financial control, and process improvement. This role focuses heavily on legal budget management, vendor coordination, contract support, and compliance with financial and procurement procedures. Working closely with Legal, Finance, and external providers, the specialist ensures transparent cost control, effective legal workflows, and well-maintained legal tools and documentation, while also contributing to team development and collaboration initiatives.

NOTE: ONLY CVs in English will be accepted

Responsibilities:

  • Budget Management

-Planning and Allocation: Develop, consolidate, and allocate the annual legal budget. Coordinate with department heads to understand budgetary needs and constraints.

-Expense Tracking and Analysis: Track, analyze, and forecast legal expenses to ensure adherence to the budget and identify cost-saving opportunities. Generate regular financial reports detailing budget performance and variances.

-Collaboration: Work with the finance team to ensure alignment on budgetary matters, financial reporting and any necessary adjustments

  • Vendor Management

-Purchase Requisitions: Handle purchase requisitions in ERP system, ensuring compliance with internal procedures and policies.

-Contract Management: Negotiate and manage contracts with external legal service providers.

-Vendor Onboarding: Oversee the onboarding of new vendors and ensure compliance with company policies and guidelines.

-Billing: Work with external law firms and vendors to resolve billing discrepancies and improve billing processes.

  • Process Management

-Efficiency Improvement: Identify inefficiencies in current legal processes and recommend improvements.

-Implementation: Implement streamlined processes to enhance productivity, efficiency, and compliance.

-Monitoring: Monitor and evaluate the effectiveness of process improvements.

  • Knowledge Management

-System Maintenance: Maintain and update legal knowledge management systems with current documentation and information.

-Resource Development: Develop and maintain user-friendly templates, forms, and documents to facilitate legal operations.

-Access and Accuracy: Ensure the legal team has easy access to accurate and up-to-date resources and guidelines.

-Best Practices: Promote best practices for knowledge sharing within the legal department.

  • Legal People & Culture

title: Inside Sales Specialist
description:
Our future is yours!

Who are we?

We are Bridge Polymers, an international company with multiple branches across Europe and

beyond. We trade in polyolefins - something you’ve probably never heard of, yet encounter

every day. These are types of plastic with hundreds of different applications. Our customers use

these plastic pellets to create their products. Our suppliers are global producers of

petrochemicals, and we focus primarily on trading polyethylene and polypropylene.

Bridge Polymers has offices in several countries, including Spain, Poland, Romania, Brazil and

more, with our headquarters based in Eindhoven, the Netherlands. The market we operate in is

fast-paced. Thanks to our straightforward, honest, and down-to-earth company culture, we can

perform at our best even in the hectic world of fast trading. We are flexible and work with short

lines of communication, allowing us to always stay on top of the business!

Your responsibilities

Working at Bridge Polymers means working on your own future within a dynamic company. This

is especially true for the Inside Sales Specialist we are currently seeking. How your journey

unfolds and where you ultimately end up is largely in your own hands.

As an Inside Sales Specialist, you will receive a structured onboarding and development

program designed to help you quickly gain confidence in your role. From day one, you will be

actively contributing while deepening your knowledge in the following areas:

Business Development & Prospection

● Research new markets and identify potential commercial opportunities.

● Analyse import statistics and market data to uncover new prospects.

● Proactively engage with potential customers through calls, emails, and LinkedIn.

● Set up daily meetings with prospects to explore potential collaborations.

● Contact customers to understand their product requirements and gather relevant market

intelligence.

Sales Support

● Prepare, create, and send offers and proformas.

● Manage follow-ups to support the full sales cycle from lead to deal.

● Assist in applying for credit limits and monitoring customer credit status.

● Follow up on payments, required documentation, and overall deal progress.

Customer Administration

● Handle day-to-day communication with prospects and clients.

● Ensure all customer data, requests, and feedback are accurately documented and

managed.

● Support the sales team by maintaining a smooth and organized administrative workflow.

In short: an excellent career outlook - and it’s up to you to fulfil your potential.

Requirements

● You have a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, International trade or similar field.

● You have at least 1–2 years of experience in a sales or business development role.

● Knowledge of import/export processes and B2B sales is a strong advantage.

● You are independent, ambitious, commercially minded, proactive, and able to perform

under pressure.

● You are fluent in spoken and written English and Portuguese.

● You are able to travel to Blumenau 2 or 3 days a week.

What we offer

● Excellent employment conditions.

● Salary progression linked to your personal growth and performance.

● Mentorship from experienced professionals to support your development.

● The opportunity to be part of a dynamic, international team.

description:
Sobre a HIKE

A HIKE é uma Creative Company que inspira e transforma pessoas e marcas através do branding, design, produção de conteúdo digital, audiovisual e ativações. Atuamos desde os primeiros passos da jornada de uma marca até a concepção de grandes projetos para gigantes globais como AMBEV, Red Bull e Unilever.

Sobre a Vaga

Essa pessoa será responsável por transformar o briefing e a VT em projetos cenográficos criativos, viáveis e alinhados aos guides de marca. Na prática, é quem equilibra conceito de marca, arquitetura e execução propondo soluções inteligentes de layout, volumetria e materiais, detalhando com rigor técnico, compatibilizando marcenaria/serralheria/elétrica e garantindo que tudo o que é desenvolvido seja exequível, seguro e com padrão high-end.

Principais Responsabilidades

Tradução criativa de briefing e VT: Interpretar briefing, dados da VT e guides de marca, convertendo necessidades em soluções cenográficas com identidade, coerência estética e viabilidade construtiva.

Conceito espacial e solução criativa: Propor ideias de layout, volumetria, fluxos, pontos de destaque e materiais que elevem a experiência e reforcem a experiência da marca, considerando restrições reais (prazo, custo, montagem, ambiente, etc).

Estudos preliminares: Desenvolver estudos iniciais (layout, volumetria e alternativas) com rapidez e repertório, apresentando opções e racional de escolha.

Anteprojeto: Construir anteprojetos com definições de implantação, medidas, linguagem de materiais e lógica construtiva 3D, garantindo base sólida para orçamento e validação.

Projeto executivo e detalhamento: Produzir projetos executivos completos (plantas, cortes, elevações e detalhamento técnico), com clareza de montagem e precisão para produção.

Especificação de materiais: Especificar materiais, acabamentos e ferragens equilibrando estética, disponibilidade, custo, durabilidade e padrão high-end.

Normas e segurança: Aplicar normas técnicas e boas práticas de segurança/estabilidade, assegurando que a solução seja segura, montável e adequada ao ambiente.

Visitas técnicas e validação em campo: Realizar visitas técnicas aos locais de instalação para levantamento de medidas, identificação de restrições, validação de premissas de projeto e alinhamento com produção e operação.

Requisitos

  • Experiência prévia como projetista em projetos espaciais (cenografia, live marketing, arquitetura efêmera, ativações de marca ou similares).
  • Capacidade de propor soluções criativas de espaço (layout, volumetria, materiais) sem perder viabilidade e segurança.

title: Purchasing Manager
description:
SWM International is a multinational company specialized in producing paper for the tobacco industry and solutions in specialty papers. We are expert manufacturers of a variety of advanced materials that are part of people’s everyday lives. We contribute to our customers’ success by delivering high-quality products and collaborating to provide innovative and customized solutions that enhance the value of their offerings.

Now, we invite you to be part of our daily journey, where each employee is essential to the success of our company.

Bring your talent to SWM!

We are currently looking for a Purchasing Manager to join our team in a permanent position at our unit in Piraí, Rio de Janeiro.

Position Objective

Lead regional operational buying teams in executing global procurement strategies while managing supplier relationships locally and interfacing with key stakeholders like plant operational and maintenance teams. This role ensures compliance, operational excellence, cost optimization, and supply continuity by bridging the gap between corporate global strategy and regional business needs.

Your challenges will include:

1. Operational Leadership & Strategy Execution

  • Manage Regional Buying Teams: Lead and develop the operational procurement team to ensure high performance, process compliance, and professional growth.
  • Implement global framework agreement: work closely with category leaders to roll out global contracts regionally, ensuring local requirements are met without compromising global leverage.
  • Drive orocess excellence: Apply Lean/Six Sigma principles to streamline the "procure-to-pay" cycle and improve regional buying efficiency.

2. Market Intelligence & Analysis

  • Monitor market trends: Analyze regional indices, competitor behavior, and technical developments to forecast price fluctuations and supply risks.
  • Benchmarking: Regularly compare regional pricing and commercial terms against competitors to maintain a competitive edge while ensuring full legal and anti-trust compliance.
  • Data-driven reporting: Consolidate market research and internal KPIs into actionable monthly reports to guide executive decision-making.

3. Supplier & Stakeholder Management

  • Local face to suppliers: Act as the primary regional point of contact for key suppliers to resolve escalations, conduct performance reviews, and ensure service level agreements (SLAs) are met.
  • Risk Mitigation: Proactively identify supply chain bottlenecks and develop alternative sourcing formulations or backup plans.
  • Sourcing: Lead team to run competitive tenders for categories under direct responsibility

4. Continuous Improvement & Compliance

  • Knowledge Leadership: Stay current on industry innovations and digital procurement tools to suggest improvements in commercial positioning.
  • EHS & Quality Standards: Ensure all regional purchasing activities strictly adhere to Health, Safety, Environment, and corporate governance guidelines.
  • Compliance: Establish and enforce local procedures, ensuring transparency in the purchasing activities

What we’re looking for:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Administration, Engineering, or related fields
  • Experience: Solid knowledge of purchasing processes, negotiation, and import/export regulations;
  • Technical Skills: Training in Purchasing and Supply Chain/ Proficiency in Microsoft Office/ Experience with ERP and P2P softwares.
  • Languages: Fluency in English, any other language is a plus
  • Availability to travel.

What we offer:

  • Eye Care: Reimbursement of up to R$ 544.00 (frames and lenses) per year.
  • Group Life Insurance: Sul América Insurance, with monthly employee contribution through payroll deduction.
  • Dental Plan: Amil 700, family, with national coverage.
  • Private pension plan
  • Christmas gift card
  • Meal voucher
  • On-site meals
  • Pharmacy voucher
  • Transportation allowance

title: Head of AML (MLRO)
description:
At bet365, we're one of the world's leading online gambling companies, revolutionising the industry since 2000. Founded by Denise Coates CBE, we now employ over 9,000 people and serve over 100 million customers in 27 languages. Our focus on In-Play betting has solidified our market-leading position, offering an unmatched experience across 96 sports and 700,000 streaming events. With over 750 concurrent sporting fixtures at peak and more live sports streamed than anyone else in Europe, we handle over 6 billion requests daily and process more than 2 million bets per hour at peak.

We empower our employees to push boundaries and explore new ideas, cultivating a culture that celebrates and rewards creativity. This offers employees a wealth of opportunities for growth, giving them the opportunity to make a real impact in the world of online gambling. As a forward-thinking company, we’re breaking new ground in software innovation too, redefining what’s possible for our customers worldwide.

Job Description

An experienced and highly motivated Head of AML (MLRO) to lead our Anti-Money Laundering (AML) efforts in Brazil.

You will be responsible for developing, implementing, and overseeing our AML programme, ensuring adherence to local regulations.

Please apply with an English version of your CV.

Qualifications

  • Relevant qualifications, including Association of Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialists (ACAMS) certification.
  • Proven experience in AML compliance within the online gambling or financial services industry.
  • In-depth knowledge of Brazilian AML regulations and international standards.

Additional Information

  • Developing and implementing a comprehensive AML strategy in line with Brazilian regulations and international best practices.
  • Acting as the Money Laundering Reporting Officer (MLRO) and serving as the primary point of contact for all AML related matters.
  • Monitoring and assessing the effectiveness of the AML programme, making necessary adjustments to policies and procedures as required.
  • Conducting risk assessments to identify and mitigate potential AML risks associated with our operations.
  • Overseeing the customer due diligence (CDD) process, ensuring compliance with KYC (Know Your Customer) requirements.
  • Providing training and guidance to staff on AML policies, procedures, and regulatory obligations.
  • Liaising with regulatory authorities, law enforcement agencies, and other stakeholders on AML matters.
  • Preparing and submitting required reports to regulatory bodies, including suspicious activity reports (SARs).
  • Keeping up to date with emerging trends and changes in AML regulations, ensuring the company remains compliant.
  • Collaborating with other departments to promote a culture of compliance and integrity within the organisation.

description:
Vaga: Coordenador de Planejamento e Produção de Eventos

Sobre a Welcome:

Somos uma empresa de assessoria em viagens com o propósito de criar experiências e transformar pessoas. Nossa atuação é dividida em três frentes especializadas: Welcome Weddings , setor especializado em Destination Wedding, com assessoria completa e personalizada desde a da produção do casamento até a viagem. A Welcome Trips que é o setor especializado em viagens de lazer, onde a personalização e a excelência são a essência de cada roteiro, e Welcome Corp, focada em viagens corporativas e de incentivo.

A Welcome Weddings é reconhecida internacionalmente como a melhor produtora de Destination Wedding da América Latina. Mais do que realizar casamentos, nossa missão é realizar o melhor dia da vida do casal.

Os setores de Planejamento e Produção de Eventos são responsáveis por conceber, organizar e coordenar todos os detalhes de um Destination Wedding, desde a escolha do destino e do local ideais até a execução impecável de cada evento. A equipe compreende profundamente o perfil e os desejos do casal, orienta nas decisões mais adequadas, realiza a reserva da data, o bloqueio de apartamentos no hotel definido e estrutura toda a programação dos eventos. Além disso, conecta o casal aos profissionais ideais e garante que cada elemento reflita sua visão, proporcionando uma experiência única, personalizada e memorável.

Sua missão:

Sua missão será liderar, integrar e garantir a excelência de todo o processo do Destination Wedding , atuando da concepção à entrega final para garantir o propósito da Welcome Weddings que é realizar o melhor dia da vida do casal.

Suas responsabilidades:

  • Coordenar a operação completa dos eventos;
  • Liderar e orientar as equipes;
  • Supervisionar a escolha dos destinos e locais;
  • Acompanhar e validar reservas e bloqueios;
  • Garantir a estruturação da programação dos eventos;
  • Assegurar a personalização e a qualidade da entrega;
  • Monitorar a experiência do casal do início ao fim.

Suas principais atividades:

Acompanhar a jornada de cada casal com base nos processos de Planejamento e Produção, garantindo alinhamento, qualidade e personalização em todas as etapas. Estruturar, aprimorar e monitorar continuamente os processos de Planejamento e Produção junto à Wedding Planner responsável por cada projeto. Apoiar as demandas operacionais dos departamentos, definindo a Wedding Planner responsável por cada casal em cada fase do processo. Conduzir reuniões estratégicas semanais com os departamentos, promovendo alinhamento e tomada de decisão. Desenvolver e capacitar os times, apoiando o Plano de Desenvolvimento Individual (PDI) de cada colaborador. Atuar como elo entre coordenadores e diretoria, assegurando comunicação clara e estratégica. Prevenir e gerenciar situações de crise, garantindo soluções rápidas, eficazes e alinhadas aos valores da empresa. Acompanhar metas e indicadores de desempenho de cada setor, identificando oportunidades de melhoria e propondo soluções. Gerir o relacionamento com fornecedores estratégicos e representar a Welcome em eventos institucionais e do mercado de eventos.

title: GenAI Solution Architect
description:
GenAI Solution Architect

Brazil/Argentina (Remote)

Full Time

In this role, you will:

  • Champion Software Excellence & Talent Development. Promote strong SDLC practices including clean architecture, automated testing, and scalable design. Mentor junior developers through code reviews, technical guidance, and collaborative learning to foster a high-performing engineering culture.
  • Lead Automation use cases architecture using technologies like GenAI, API, D&A, etc, working closely with Product Managers, automation engineers and stakeholders across business and DTS, and Enterprise Architecture.
  • End-to-End Platform Development. Build and maintain front-end (React, TypeScript, Next.js) and back-end (Python, FastAPI, Node.js) layers that support GenAI workflows and agentic interactions.
  • API & Agent Framework Integration. Design robust REST and GraphQL APIs for real-time agent communication, tool execution, and memory handling. Integrate frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, and vector databases (Pinecone, FAISS, Chroma, Weaviate).
  • ETL & Data Pipeline Architecture. Architect and optimize ETL pipelines for real-time and batch data processing. Ensure seamless data flow between GenAI services, databases, and user interfaces.
  • Cloud-Native Deployment & Monitoring. Deploy and scale services using Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines. Apply MLOps best practices for monitoring, versioning, and performance tuning of AI components.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration. Work closely with AI researchers, product managers, and delivery teams to align technical execution with strategic goals. Participate in multi-agent orchestration experiments and rapid prototyping cycles.

Technical Expertise:

  • Cloud Platform Proficiency: Solid experience (minimum 5 years) in architecting, deploying, and managing applications across leading cloud platforms, demonstrating comprehensive knowledge of cloud services including computing, database management, application development, and integration services. Familiarity with cloud-native services (Azure), containerization (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes), and serverless architectures is highly valued.
  • Embedded Systems and CI/CD: Experience with embedded devices, operating systems, and server-client architecture. Proficient in CI/CD and DevSecOps practices.
  • Architecture Design: Experience in Microservices and Event-Driven Architecture. Understanding architecture design principles and patterns. Experience with SQL Server, Web Services (SOAP/REST) and API development.
  • .NET Development Skills: Extensive hands-on experience in building scalable, high-performance applications using .NET technologies, with strong capabilities in C#, .NET Core, ASP.NET, and Entity Framework. Knowledge of web technologies and frameworks, such as Blazor or ASP.NET MVC, is also crucial.
  • Integration with SAP and Salesforce: Demonstrated ability to integrate .NET applications with both SAP and Salesforce platforms, employing APIs and middleware solutions like SAP Process Orchestration or API to facilitate robust data exchange and streamline workflows across these systems.
  • Security and Compliance: Deep understanding of security practices related to cloud-hosted applications, including implementing secure authentication and authorization mechanisms (e.g., OAuth, OpenID Connect) and ensuring compliance with relevant industry security standards.
  • Scalability and High Availability: Proven expertise in designing applications that are highly scalable and resilient, leveraging cloud scalability features such as load balancing, auto-scaling, and caching services to ensure optimal performance and availability.
  • Agile Development Practices: Strong background in Agile methodologies, adept at managing product backlogs, user stories, sprint planning, and releases, particularly within a cloud-hosted application development environment.
  • Strategic Problem Solving and Analytical Thinking: Ability to address complex technical and integration challenges with a strategic mindset, utilizing analytical and data-driven decision-making to optimize the application's performance and capabilities.

Specialized Skills:

  • Prototyping: Ability to engage in rapid prototype development using iterative techniques.
  • Vendor and Partner Engagement: Direct experience managing relationships with outsourcing and consulting partners.
  • Cloud Architecture Design: Deep understanding of cloud solutions and architectures, enabling scalable, flexible, and resilient digital infrastructures that support rapid innovation and development.

Soft Skills and Others:

  • Agile Collaboration: Demonstrated experience in effectively working with Agile and Product teams, including involvement with epics, user stories, sprints, and backlog management. The ability to collaborate closely with product owners, engineers, and scrum master’s to foster a productive and agile environment.
  • Leadership in Communication and Reporting: Skilled in leading communication efforts and reporting, adept at preparing and presenting comprehensive updates and reports to senior leaders and stakeholders. Ability to succinctly highlight key metrics, progress, and insights, ensuring transparency and alignment at all levels of the organization.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Background in coordinating hardware & software development teams and business owners, with the ability to influence SMEs directly.

title: Estágio em desenvolvimento de software
description:
A Empresa:

A Hexagon é líder global em soluções de realidade digital, combinando sensores, software e tecnologias autônomas. Estamos colocando dados para trabalhar para aumentar a eficiência, produtividade, qualidade e segurança em aplicações industriais, de fabricação, infraestrutura, setor público e mobilidade.

Nossas tecnologias estão moldando os ecossistemas de produção e relacionados às pessoas para se tornarem cada vez mais conectados e independentes — garantindo um futuro escalável e sustentável.

A divisão de Mineração da Hexagon resolve os desafios das minas subterrâneas e de superfície com tecnologias comprovadas para planejamento, operações e segurança.

A Hexagon (Nasdaq Estocolmo: HEXA B) tem aproximadamente 24.000 funcionários em 50 países e vendas líquidas de aproximadamente 5,5 bilhões de dólares. Saiba mais em hexagon.com e siga-nos em @HexagonAB.

Objetivo do estágio:

Estamos à procura de um estagiário para fazer parte de uma equipe de desenvolvimento de software. A equipe é responsável por desenvolver software para os produtos do portfólio da Hexagon Mining, contribuindo em todos os aspectos do ciclo de vida do desenvolvimento de software, utilizando tecnologias como C# /. Net e C / C ++ e Linux.

Suas principais responsabilidades estão relacionadas a ajudar o time a desenvolver e manter estas aplicações, sendo que você receberá treinamentos e orientações da equipe quanto às atividades a serem realizadas. Portanto, um compromisso com a solução colaborativa de problemas é essencial.

Responsabilidades:

· Apoiar na transformação de designs e casos de uso em aplicações funcionais.

· Auxiliar na identificação de bugs e no desenvolvimento de soluções para estes problemas.

· Ajudar a manter a qualidade do código, organização e testes automatizados.

Habilidades e Competências:

Necessário:

  • Estar regularmente matriculado(a) em uma instituição de ensino superior em cursos como Engenharia de Software, Ciência da Computação e afins
  • Inglês intermediário ou avançado
  • Trabalho em equipe
  • Bom conhecimento em lógica de programação
  • Bom conhecimento em programação orientada a objetos
  • Abertura para aprender e trabalhar com diversas tecnologias

Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento ou familiaridade do processo SCRUM ou outras metodologias ágeis
  • Conhecimento ou familiaridade geral com alguma das linguagens / tecnologias: Objective-C, C/C++
  • Conhecimento de programação e API em um dos, e familiaridade geral com os sistemas operacionais: Linux, Microsoft Windows
  • Familiaridade com banco de dados
  • Familiaridade sobre controle de versão de código, como Git

Benefícios :

  • Plano de Saúde
  • Seguro de Vida
  • Plano Odontológico
  • Gympass (Wellhub)
  • Vale alimentação/refeição
  • Programa de Saúde Integral: psicologia, nutrição, jurídico, financeiro e social

Junte-se à nossa equipe como um estagiário e cause um impacto significativo nas iniciativas de transformação digital dos nossos clientes. Ofereçemos um ambiente de trabalho estimulante, pacote de remuneração competitivo e oportunidades de crescimento profissional e possível contratação. Inscreva-se agora e ajude a moldar o futuro das soluções tecnológicas da Hexagon.

A Hexagon é uma Empregadora de Oportunidades Iguais. Proibimos discriminação contra qualquer candidato a emprego com base em características protegidas.

description:
Qual desafio temos para você?

Estamos em busca de um(a) Instrutor(a) Operações Agrícolas para atuar no time de Operações Agrícolas.

Quais as responsabilidades?

Atuar de forma especializada nas operações: Preparo de solo, plantio mecanizado e tratos culturais de cana-de-açúcar;

Disseminar melhores padrões de operação, através de treinamento/desenvolvimento constante, em campo e sala, de operadores/motoristas;

Monitorar indicadores de performance do operador, como consumo de combustível, velocidade/rotação de motor, rendimento, qualidade de operação, etc;

Mapear e registrar pontos críticos, propondo soluções com olhar de melhoria contínua;

Apoiar a implementação de novos projetos, como implantação de novas tecnologias;

Realizar avaliação técnica de candidatos às posições de operadores/motoristas;

Quais os requisitos?

Conhecimento básico em mecânica/elétrica de veículos;

CNH E;

Disponibilidade para turnos e residir em Olímpia/SP.

Qual localidade?

Olímpia/SP

O que buscamos num profissional?

Neste cenário de crescimento sustentável, buscamos talentos para enfrentar os desafios do setor, que tenham atitude, sejam engajados e saibam estabelecer parcerias na busca pela excelência.

A Tereos acredita que todos os profissionais podem contribuir com o crescimento do grupo. Por isso, pessoas com deficiência são bem-vindas a nossa empresa.

Sobre a Tereos

Com visão de longo prazo no processamento de matérias-primas agrícolas e desenvolvimento de produtos alimentícios de qualidade, a Tereos é uma das líderes nos mercados de açúcar, álcool/etanol e amidos. Os compromissos do Grupo com a sociedade e com o meio ambiente têm contribuído com a performance da companhia no longo prazo, enquanto reforça nossa atuação responsável. O Grupo cooperativo Tereos reúne 12.000 agricultores e possui expertise reconhecida no processamento de beterraba, cana-de-açúcar, cereais e batata. Com operação em 15 países, 43 unidades industriais e o compromisso de 15.800 colaboradores, a Tereos atende seus clientes em seus mercados locais, com uma oferta ampla de produtos. Em 2022/23, o Grupo obteve um faturamento de € 6,6 bilhões.

Tereos no Brasil

A Tereos no Brasil é composta pela Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil, Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil e Tereos Commodities Brasil. No noroeste do Estado de São Paulo, a Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil concentra suas sete unidades de processamento e duas refinarias. A Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil, com operação em Palmital (SP), diversifica o portfólio da Tereos Brasil com a fabricação de produtos derivados de milho. A Tereos Commodities opera como trading e possui escritórios em diversos países.

description:
Who are we?

Samsung Electronics has grown into one of the world’s leading technology companies, recognized as one of the top 5 global brands. As a global leader in technology, we are transforming the world with the creativity and diversity of our talented people who drive this transformation.

Our company's success reflects the determination and talent of our people, aligned with our key corporate values: People, Excellence, Change, Integrity, and Co-prosperity. Our mission is to help people achieve the impossible.

Join us at Samsung and find your opportunity to do what you can't.

Looking for more? Visit our website or our career page HERE !

Job Overview:

The Security & Loss Prevention Supervisor is responsible for leading the implementation of security services and asset protection across all logistics activities, including transportation, warehouses, and hubs. This role oversees the Security & Loss Prevention department, conducting audits and investigations to minimize potential losses for the organization. Coordinates responses to on-road incidents such as thefts, pilferages, and accidents, and evaluates vendors to identify vulnerabilities and propose mitigation strategies. As a key member of the logistics team, they collaborate with operational teams, internal departments like Legal and Finance, as well as external security authorities. Additionally, they work with internal and external stakeholders to continuously improve existing solutions, explore new approaches, conduct industry benchmarking, and track established metrics for loss prevention.

Key Job Responsibilities:

  • Be aware of the goals and direction of the Company and align all decisions and activities to support that direction and achieve the goals, which are key performance indicators, allowing performance improvements.
  • Lead investigations of internal and external occurrences, some cases involving police department in all states.
  • Serve as department’s liaison and security matter expert.
  • Develop business cases which receive the required approval, financial and technical resources, and the support of appropriate management to enact desired changes
  • Drive process improvements and increase efficiency by apply innovation initiatives (AI, drones, new technologies, etc.).
  • Designing and implementing the security and loss prevention strategy, standards and procedures.
  • Driving internal and external (vendors) audits to ensure that losses are kept at a minimal level.
  • Designing security procedures for all logistics processes, mainly for transportation and warehouses.
  • Effectively address security incidents. Detecting and addressing any discrepancies/pilferage for key metrics.
  • Participate in projects like warehouse layout (placement or cameras, security system, etc) and transportation monitoring center software as examples.
  • Background & Experience
  • A completed Bachelor’s Degree from an accredited university
  • Prior experience in law enforcement, asset protection, audit, risk management or other related security field
  • Familiarity with security equipment such as intrusion detection devices, access control systems, alarms, and CCTVs;
  • Results oriented leader that possesses strong influencing skill and is comfortable working in a fast-paced ambiguous environment while prioritizing and managing multiple responsibilities;
  • Analytical leader experienced in performance based, action and results oriented management, and effective problem-solver;
  • Ability to take calculated risks and challenge current practices to develop and deliver innovative solutions to meet or exceed the customer expectations.
  • English level intermediate is mandatory.

  • Data-driven mindset: skilled at funnel metrics, reporting, and insights.

Preferred

Buscamos um(a) Analista Pleno de Sourcing para atuar de forma integrada com Estilo, Qualidade, Importação e Comercial, acompanhando todo o ciclo do produto — do pedido à chegada no CD.

Se você é organizado(a), analítico(a), tem boa comunicação e interesse em produto, vestuário e varejo, essa vaga é para você.

Seus desafios no dia a dia

  • Apoiar nos processos de cotação e definição da cadeia de fornecimento (nacional e importado);
  • Garantir os prazos e visibilidade de status;
  • Organizar, checar e salvar PI’s de fornecedores importados, assegurando o correto envio ao time de Importação;
  • Garantir o envio correto das informações dos pedidos aos fornecedores, mantendo alinhamento e clareza;
  • Realizar follow-up com fornecedores nacionais e importados (Labdips, Price Tags, Fit Samples, PPS, inspeções e embarques);
  • Solicitar e acompanhar ajustes de custo, quantidade, PDV, embarque e entrega junto ao time de CS;
  • Atualizar e comunicar alterações de pedidos aos fornecedores, mantendo os controles atualizados;
  • Acompanhar o recebimento dos produtos desde a origem até o CD;
  • Conduzir análises da área (LY vs. atual), considerando compra, venda e margem;
  • Apoiar a organização de Pré-Showrooms e Showrooms, incluindo agendamentos e materiais de apresentação;
  • Realizar visitas a lojas próprias e concorrentes para análise de preços, produtos, tendências e oportunidades.

O que esperamos de você

  • Formação superior em Administração, Comércio Exterior, Relações Internacionais ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência prévia em Sourcing, Compras, Supply Chain ou áreas relacionadas;
  • Conhecimento básico de produto, especialmente vestuário e acessórios, e entendimento de varejo;
  • Inglês intermediário a avançado (leitura e escrita), considerando que parte relevante da base de fornecedores é importada;
  • Excel em nível intermediário/avançado;
  • Perfil analítico, organizado, proativo e com facilidade de relacionamento;
  • Experiência com follow-up de fornecedores nacionais e internacionais.

Diferenciais que contam pontos

  • Vivência com importação e processos de comércio exterior;
  • Experiência em varejo esportivo, moda ou bens de consumo;
  • Pós-graduação em Moda, Supply Chain, Negócios ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência com análises de margem, compra e venda.

O que você encontra por aqui

  • Atuação em uma área estratégica e integrada ao desenvolvimento de produtos;
  • Contato direto com fornecedores nacionais e internacionais;
  • Ambiente colaborativo, dinâmico e com forte troca entre áreas;
  • Oportunidade de crescimento e desenvolvimento dentro da cadeia de produto.

Se você quer atuar no coração do sourcing, acompanhando produtos do início ao fim e fazendo parte de uma operação que movimenta o esporte no Brasil, vem jogar com a gente.

title: Analista Júnior de Assuntos Regulatórios
description:
Analista Júnior de Assuntos Regulatórios

A Hy Cite Enterprises é uma empresa global de venda direta ao consumidor, comprometida em oferecer produtos inovadores e experiências excepcionais. A companhia promove uma cultura centrada nas pessoas, na integridade e no crescimento contínuo, com presença em diversos mercados internacionais.

title: Finance Senior Analyst
description:
About MGI

In April 2024, MGI Tech opened a Customer Experience Center in Brazil to contribute to the advancement of genomics in Latin America. The goal is to provide a facility for clinical and research laboratories, hospitals, and universities to enhance learning and experience with genetic sequencing technology, applied in precision medicine, oncology, Agri genomics (the application of genomics in agriculture), and metagenomics (the study of environmental microbial communities), among other segments. MGI Brazil is committed to enabling effective and affordable healthcare solutions for all. Based on its proprietary technology, MGI produces sequencing devices, equipment, consumables, and reagents to support life science research, medicine, and healthcare. MGI is recognized globally as an innovator and for conducting international collaborative projects with leading research institutions for the betterment of mankind and the world in which we live. MGI values its employees, as we believe they are the driving force behind our success and commercial expansion globally.

POSITION PROFILE

MGI is seeking an in-country finance professional to play an important role in the expansion of business operations in Brazil. This position will be responsible for ensuring accurate and timely financials for MGI-Brazil as well as managing the contract accounting firm for Brazil operations and liaison with the commercial team in Brazil. In order to achieve success in this role the position requires the ability to collaborate effectively across all functions and levels, as well as across international boundaries, with finance teams in the US and Shenzhen, China.

Reporting to the US Finance Director, the position is based in São Paulo, Brazil.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Financial Operation:

  • Oversee day-to-day accounting operations, including accounts payable, accounts receivable, payroll, and general ledger activities.
  • Support customer invoicing and sales tax calculation.
  • Ensure timely and accurate processing of financial transactions.
  • Maintain and improve internal controls and financial procedures.
  • Support financial processes and IT system improvements (e.g., CRM, Oracle ERP, Concur, internally designed Shared Service Platform)

Month-end Closing and Reporting:

  • Responsible for over-seeing the contract accounting team in Brazil.
  • Prepare Month-end closing and ensure accurate and timely Finance Statements are submitted to HQ Reporting team.
  • Arrange stock take and fixed assets take procedures.

Tax Compliance and annual audit support:

  • Ensure compliance with local and international accounting standards and regulatory requirements.
  • Work with tax consultants to prepare and file tax returns, ensuring compliance with local tax regulations.
  • Support group annual audit procedures (i.e. audit confirmations and PBC list)

Cash Management:

  • Monitor and manage the company's cash flow, ensuring sufficient liquidity for operations.
  • Own the cash management function and liaison with treasury administrator in US.

Budgeting and Forecasting:

  • Participate in the annual budgeting process for MGI Brazil and Actual v Budget analysis.
  • Monitor financial performance against budgets and forecasts, identifying variances and recommending corrective actions.

Commercial Team Support:

  • Build relationships with and support the Brazil Commercial team.
  • Identify opportunities for cost reduction and efficiency improvements.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • At least 5 years of relevant accounting experience in a fast-paced, fluid, results-oriented, hands-on environment, including with teams that are geographically dispersed across international boundaries.
  • Strong knowledge of accounting principles, financial regulations, and reporting standards.
  • Experience with ERP and Financial IT systems (e.g., CRM, Oracle ERP, Concur, etc.)
  • BS/BA degree in Accounting/Finance/Business. CPA a plus.
  • Biotechnology/Medical Devices/Pharmaceutical industry experience and multinational experience; experience with import tax a plus.
  • Proven experience in instrument sales or related industry is a plus.
  • Knowledge of Portuguese and English is required. Chinese language a plus.
  • Must have strong excel skills.

BEHAVIORS, SKILLS, AND KNOWLEDGE

  • Team-oriented with outstanding integrity, accuracy, and organizational skills.
  • Ability to proactively identify and solve problems.
  • Exhibits the highest degree of integrity and ethics, with the ability to work independently and with minimal supervision.
  • Strong team player willing to be flexible and to tackle a variety of tasks and responsibilities.
  • Ability to navigate and be successful in a highly matrixed, fast-paced environment.
  • Results-oriented with excellent analytic, communication, and collaboration skills
  • Ability to operate under different business models and complex business structures.

description:

E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

title: API Engineer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for API Designer/Engineer who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

Overview

The API Designer/Engineer is a pivotal role responsible for implementing API Design First principles to create scalable, secure, and consumer-centric APIs. The candidate will focus on designing API specifications and frameworks that ensure seamless developer experiences while meeting Customer's API standards and architectural guidelines.

Key Responsibilities

API Design & Development

  • Adopt an API Design First Approach : Leverage OpenAPI (Swagger), RAML, or AsyncAPI specifications to define APIs before implementation, ensuring clarity and alignment across stakeholders.
  • API Specification Creation : Design API specifications that adhere to Customer's API standards, covering endpoints, data structures, error handling, and response codes.
  • Policy Design and Configuration : Define and configure API policies (security, routing, transformation, throttling, etc.) using tools such as Azure API Management (APIM).
  • Mock API Development : Create mock APIs for early-stage validation and testing to facilitate integration and feedback before development.
  • API Testing : Perform unit testing of API specifications to ensure functionality, reliability, and adherence to defined standards.
  • Environment Configuration : Configure API backend settings within APIM (naming conventions, App Insights, Key Vault) in DEV, UAT, and PRD environments.
  • API Deployment : Deploy draft APIs into the Azure APIM Dev instance and promote them across DEV, UAT, and PRD environments using the API DevOps framework.
  • Documentation : Create comprehensive API documentation, including references, developer guides, and examples, in line with Customer's standards.
  • Metadata Publishing : Publish API Identity Cards (metadata, usage information) to the Azure API Management Developer Portal to enable easy discovery and adoption by consumers.

API Consumer Onboarding

  • Secure Authentication Setup : Configure OAuth/OpenID Connect to ensure secure authentication and authorization for API consumers.
  • Subscription Key Management : Share API subscription keys securely with consumers and maintain robust tracking mechanisms.
  • Integration Testing Support : Collaborate with API consumers during integration testing to resolve issues and provide guidance on proper usage.

Testing & Validation

  • Functional Testing : Conduct and support API functional, integration, and performance testing to validate API readiness and scalability.
  • Mock and Staging Environment Management : Ensure availability of mock services and staging environments for API testing and feedback gathering.

Skills and Expertise

  • API Design First Expertise : Proficient in designing APIs using OpenAPI, SwaggerHub, or similar tools with a focus on consumer-first design principles.
  • Azure API Management : Deep experience in configuring and managing APIs using Azure API Management.
  • Security Standards : Strong knowledge of OAuth2, OpenID Connect, and API key management best practices.
  • Documentation Excellence : Skilled in creating developer-friendly documentation and API identity cards.
  • Testing Proficiency : Familiarity with API testing frameworks and methodologies to validate functionality and performance. Proficient in using Postman tool

What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

While all coordinators will work within MDM processes, there are two distinct specializations :

Location & Administrative Maintenance:

  • Set up new locations and update existing records in MDM
  • Manage location name changes, moves, closures, and inactivations

  • College degree preferred (not required)

1. Provide professional services to Murex clients:

o Provide services in the domain of system integration, business intelligence and data flows through the full lifecycle of the MX.3: requirements analysis, configuration build, installation, training, upgrade, and production support.

o Professionally interact with Murex colleagues and clients.

2. Build, test, and provide support to clients on MX.3 integration modules.

o Contribute to project implementations

 Participate in design, build, and test phases sometimes remotely and other times at the client site as needed.

 Develop trade workflows and interfaces to set up communication between external platforms and murex to receive trade and other data feeds, process them, save into the system, and send acknowledgement. Use a combination of MXMLExchange, MXopenconnect, Murex APIs, and Datamart to successfully deliver such solutions.

 Contribute to functional documentation of the test cases and use cases by the client.

 Contribute to Design documentation for the Build process of the Product.

 Develop and maintain end-to-end configuration management packages etc. Install, Deploy and test Murex packaged interfaces like MDIT (market data interface tool), Markitwire, BSMT and MarkitCredit to receive live and end-of-day data from external providers like Bloomberg, Reuters, Markit, etc.

o Handle support cases from notification to resolution and validation.

• Participate in the business as usual and project support: follow-up of client open cases through email, CRM portal, phone-calls and on-site visits

• Develop an understanding of ongoing activities and manage own deliverables / progress

• Manage bug fixes and enhancements with the Product Team

3. Integrate with various teams to deliver the right solution to client.

o Work with S4C stream leads, Front-Office, Back-Office, or Risk teams to understand requirements and develop solutions for the client.

o Work with the Product division team to provide them timely details on defects - how to reproduce the issue, project/client constraints, and how to validate the fix.

o Follow up with the S4C stream leads, the Project Manager, and other teams to meet deadlines and regular meetings to make sure the delivery is on time.

4. Work with technologies including SQL, Unix, and Murex proprietary standards like Murex Scripting Language (MSL), XMLF, etc. for client solutions.

o Use SQL for end-of-day report generation, STP (straight through processing) failure issues, P&L evaluation, for analyzing issues in trade feed and status Etc.

o Java programming skills are not essential but are a plus.

o Various Murex proprietary languages and formats: Data Query Language for querying in various screens in MX.3, MSL (Murex Scripting Language) for pre-trade logic, XMLF for post-trade flow processing, MxML in various contexts, etc.

o Create shell/python scripts for automation of day-to-day manual activities.

Understand requirements, analyze the problem areas of the current system and behavior of pre- trade and post-trade workflow, and integration points.

- SQL; XML; MxML; UNIX; Scripting languages

title: GoHigh Level Specialist
description:
GoHigh Level Specialist

Company: OutfitMD

Department: Operations / Technology

Reports To: CEO & Leadership Team

Role Overview

The GoHigh Level Specialist is responsible for owning, managing, and optimizing the entire backend technology and automation infrastructure for OutfitMD. This role serves as the internal technical authority for CRM systems, workflows, automations, integrations, and platform performance.

This position ensures OutfitMD has full internal control, visibility, and scalability of its systems. The role is highly technical, execution-focused, and critical to the company’s ability to scale efficiently By maintaining strong internal ownership of platform logic and automation, this role enables seamless operations across Sales, Implementation, Client Success, and Marketing ensuring systems evolve alongside the business and can reliably support increased volume, complexity, and long-term expansion.

Primary Objectives

• Own and manage OutfitMD’s CRM and automation ecosystem

• Build, maintain, and optimize GHL workflows and automations

• Eliminate dependency on external GHL vendors

• Ensure system stability, scalability, and performance

• Support Implementation, Client Success, and Sales through reliable systems

Core Responsibilities

CRM & Automation Ownership

• Serve as the primary internal expert for GoHighLevel

• Build and maintain workflows, automations, triggers, and pipelines

• Configure forms, calendars, intake processes, and communication logic

• Manage integrations with third-party tools (SMS, email, payment processors, etc.)

• Maintain clean data structures, tagging, and segmentation

Implementation & Technical Support

• Support Implementation Support Specialists with backend builds

• Execute technical setup for new client portals

• Troubleshoot automation failures, bugs, and system issues

• Test and QA systems before client launch

System Optimization & Scaling

• Identify inefficiencies, redundancies, and automation gaps

• Optimize workflows for speed, accuracy, and scalability

• Prepare systems to support increased client volume

• Document technical SOPs and system logic

Security, Compliance & Reliability

• Ensure systems follow best practices for data handling and access control

• Manage user permissions and access levels

• Monitor system uptime and automation health

Internal Collaboration

• Work closely with Sales, Implementation, Client Success, and Marketing

• Translate business needs into technical solutions

• Provide leadership with technical insight and recommendations

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

• Automation reliability and uptime

• Reduction in system errors or failures

• Time to resolve technical issues

• Successful internalization of GHL management

• System scalability and performance metrics

Required Skills & Qualifications

• Advanced experience with GoHighLevel CRM

• Advanced English

• Strong understanding of automation logic and workflows

• Experience with CRM architecture, pipelines, and data structure

• Ability to troubleshoot technical issues independently

• Strong documentation and organizational skills

• Ability to communicate technical concepts to non-technical teams

Preferred

• Experience replacing or auditing third-party CRM vendors

• Background in SaaS, automation, or technical operations

• Familiarity with HIPAA-aware systems (non-clinical)

Why this role matters at outfitmd

The GoHighLevel Specialist ensures our marketing and sales systems run efficiently and produce measurable results. This role is responsible for setting up and optimizing automations, funnels, and CRM workflows so every lead is properly captured, followed up with, and moved through the sales process without manual effort.

By translating business goals into scalable systems, the GoHighLevel Specialist reduces lead loss, improves conversion rates, and supports sustainable growth. This role turns GoHighLevel into a reliable, revenue-driving platform rather than just another software tool.

title: Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:

It requires a high level of autonomy, strong stakeholder management, and a consultative approach to ensure high-quality, timely hires in a competitive market. The Senior Talent Acquisition Partner helps shape hiring plans, advise on talent trends, and champion client’s growth across LATAM.

Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Manage full-cycle recruitment across Engineering, Product, and GTM roles in the LATAM region — from intake through offer.

  • Translate market research into actionable hiring strategies, including competitor insights, compensation trends, and talent availability.
  • Own the candidate experience, ensuring timely communication, smooth process flow, and alignment with client’s brand.

  • Contribute to continuous improvement efforts, including interview process design, DEI initiatives, and talent analytics.

Required Qualifications:

  • 5–10 years of professional experience in full-cycle recruiting, ideally across technical and go-to-market roles.
  • Proven success recruiting in the LATAM region, with a strong understanding of local talent markets.
  • Fluent in both English and Spanish; able to communicate effectively across diverse stakeholders.
  • Skilled in sourcing and candidate engagement using tools like LinkedIn Recruiter.
  • Comfortable working independently and managing multiple roles with competing priorities.
  • Experience advising senior stakeholders on hiring decisions, market insights, and strategy.
  • Proficiency with applicant tracking systems; Workday experience is a plus.
  • Demonstrated ability to incorporate AI tools and technology into recruiting workflows.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Portuguese language proficiency.
  • Prior recruiting experience within SaaS or high-growth product companies.
  • Familiarity with Workday or similar enterprise-level ATS platforms.

title: React Developer
description:
Role Overview

We are seeking a React Developer to join our Reinforcement Learning (RL) Gym project. You will be responsible for building and maintaining intuitive, high-performance web interfaces that enable researchers and engineers to visualize, interact with, and manage reinforcement learning workflows. This role requires strong React expertise and the ability to collaborate closely with backend and ML teams to deliver seamless user experiences.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain responsive web applications using React.
  • Build reusable UI components and libraries to support experimentation workflows.
  • Collaborate with backend engineers to integrate APIs and ensure smooth data flow.
  • Work with engineers and researchers to create visualizations for training, evaluation, and benchmarking results.
  • Optimize applications for performance, scalability, and cross-browser compatibility.
  • Ensure high code quality with testing, reviews, and adherence to best practices.
  • Troubleshoot issues, debug code, and contribute to continuous improvements in the frontend stack.

Requirements

  • 4+ years of professional experience in frontend development, with a strong focus on React.
  • Solid understanding of JavaScript / TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS3.
  • Experience with state management libraries
  • Familiarity with RESTful APIs and integration with backend services.
  • Knowledge of frontend testing frameworks
  • Understanding of build tools and CI/CD workflows
  • Strong problem-solving, debugging, and communication skills.
  • Good to have: Experience with data visualization libraries (e.g., D3.js, Chart.js, Recharts) or exposure to ML/AI project interfaces.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.

Important Notes for Submission

  • Kindly prioritize candidates with immediate availability and confirm their commitment to 8 - 4 hrs/day with PST overlap.

Offer Details

  • Commitments Required: Full-time (8 hours/day). At least 4 hours per day and minimum 20 hours per week with an overlap of 4 hours with PST.
  • Engagement Type: Contractor assignment (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of Contract: 3 months (adjustable based on engagement)
  • Location: India, Pakistan, Nigeria, Kenya, Egypt, Ghana, Bangladesh, Turkey, Brazil, Mexico.

Evaluation Process

  • Candidates complete Interest Check Form (ICF)
  • Shortlisted candidates only will be invited for MTI

description:

A Genial Investimentos é uma das maiores plataformas de investimentos do Brasil. Com mais de 2 milhões de clientes, estamos presentes em todo o país por meio de nossos escritórios e assessores parceiros.

#VemSerGenial

  • Experiência na comercialização de produtos financeiros e assessoria direta com cliente final;

  • Residir no Rio de Janeiro ou possuir disponibilidade para mudanças;
  • Perfil empreendedor.

  • Assistência Odontológica (Omint)

  • Vale Refeição e Vale Alimentação (Alelo)

  • Conexa Saúde
  • TotalPass e Wellhub
  • Programa de Participação nos Resultados (PPR)

Nosso escritório fica localizado em Belo Horizonte.

Etapas do processo

  1. Cadastro
  2. Validação Talent Attraction
  3. Validação Gestor
  4. Validação Area Parceira 1
  5. Proposta
  6. Contratação

Venha ser Genial você também!

O que é ser Genial?

É buscar a excelência, é fazer acontecer. É ser talentoso, inteligente, curioso e aceitar qualquer desafio. É se apresentar e defender as suas ideias. É colocar o cliente em primeiro lugar e ser apaixonado pelo que faz.

Por que a Genial?

Porque somos digitais, mas também somos humanos. Se você, assim como nós, acredita que investimento não é sinônimo de terno e gravata, queremos conhecer você!

Sobre Nós

A empresa que investe em você! Descomplicamos o mercado financeiro para que nossos clientes consigam tomar boas decisões na hora de investir.

Nossos Valores

Buscar os melhores resultados para os clientes;

Colocar excelência em tudo que fazemos;

Ser uma empresa responsável, transparente e sustentável;

Inovar para inspirar;

Ser apaixonado pelo que faz;

Aprender e melhorar sempre.

title: Especialista em segurança do trabalho
description:
O Projeto Sucuriú marca a entrada da divisão de celulose da Arauco no Brasil. O investimento de US$4.6 bilhões inclui a construção de uma planta com capacidade de produção de 3,5 milhões de toneladas de fibra curta de celulose/ano. Está localizado em uma área de 3.500 hectares, a 50 quilômetros do centro da cidade de Inocência (MS) e ao lado do Rio Sucuriú. A etapa de terraplanagem começou em 2024 e a previsão de entrada em operação é no final de 2027. Em todas as fases desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e respeita a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação. Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up, o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos.

Sobre a Arauco Brasil

No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras. As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose brasileira em Inocência (MS). Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

Sobre a Função

DESAFIO

Aplicar as estratégias de Segurança do trabalho e Emergências, trabalhando na prevenção de acidentes e promoção da saúde ocupacional, fazendo cumprir as normas de segurança, monitorando indicadores, se antecipando e evitando situações de Emergências e/ou acidentes, garantindo a consolidação da cultura de segurança, visando um ambiente seguro para todos os colaboradores e minimizando riscos operacionais em sua área de atuação.

Atividades principais

  • Elaborar, buscar aprovação, implementar e manter políticas e programas de segurança do trabalho, alinhados às legislações vigentes (NRs – Normas Regulamentadoras) e às necessidades da sua área de atuação promovendo a cultura de segurança no ambiente de trabalho, assegurando que todos os colaboradores conheçam e sigam as diretrizes de segurança;
  • Identificar riscos potenciais nas atividades da sua área de atuação;
  • Treinar e conscientizar os colaboradores sobre a importância do uso de EPIs e supervisionar sua utilização no ambiente de trabalho, assim como, garantir que os EPIs estejam em conformidade com as regulamentações e com a NR-6;
  • Planejar e ministrar treinamentos obrigatórios e periódicos sobre segurança do trabalho, como NR-12 (Segurança em Máquinas e Equipamentos), NR-33 (Espaços Confinados) e NR-35 (Trabalho em Altura), entre outros;
  • Treinar equipes de emergência e primeiros socorros, capacitando os colaboradores para agir em casos de acidentes ou situações críticas.
  • Realizar inspeções regulares nas áreas produtivas, verificando as condições de trabalho, equipamentos, máquinas e infraestrutura para identificar e corrigir potenciais irregularidades;
  • Coordenar auditorias internas e externas de segurança, bem como, acompanhar as auditorias de certificação como OHSAS 18001 ou ISO 45001, e implementar planos de ação para melhorias contínuas na segurança dos colaboradores;
  • Investigar acidentes e incidentes de trabalho, levantando dados, fatos e evidências, realizando as análises conforme metodologia pré-definida;
  • Monitorar e analisar os indicadores de segurança;
  • Implementar e manter programas como o Programa de Prevenção de Riscos Ambientais (PPRA) e o Programa de Controle Médico de Saúde Ocupacional (PCMSO) , em conformidade com a NR-9 e NR-7;
  • Implementar o Plano de Atendimento a Emergências (PAE) , assegurando que os colaboradores estejam preparados para lidar com emergências;
  • Coordenar a eleição, formação e atuação da CIPA , em conformidade com a NR-5, garantindo a capacitação dos participantes;
  • Garantir que os sistemas de prevenção e combate a incêndios estejam instalados, funcionando adequadamente e em conformidade com a legislação vigente;
  • Desenvolver e acompanhar KPIs (indicadores-chave de desempenho) de segurança, como taxa de frequência de acidentes , taxa de gravidade , acidentes com afastamento etc.;
  • Colaborar com o setor de saúde ocupacional para monitorar a saúde dos trabalhadores;
  • Manter atualizados os documentos de segurança, como laudos técnicos, PPRA, PCMSO, LTCAT (Laudo Técnico de Condições Ambientais de Trabalho) e relatórios de inspeções e auditorias;
  • Elaborar relatórios periódicos de segurança, apresentando os resultados e avanços das iniciativas implementadas à diretoria e às áreas operacionais;
  • Garantir que todas as práticas de segurança estejam em conformidade com as normas regulamentadoras do Ministério do Trabalho;
  • Participar e apoiar projetos de melhorias, inovação, modificações e modernização de sistemas e processos relacionados à Segurança do trabalho e Emergências;
  • Outras atividades correlatas;

title: Técnico em Segurança do Trabalho
description:
Atualmente a AutoZone é líder em venda no mercado mundial, com mais de 7.000 lojas no Brasil, México e EUA.

O ano de 2012 marca o início de sua presença no Brasil, onde inaugurou sua primeira loja em Sorocaba. Desde então, a AutoZone tem conquistado reconhecimento e forte presença em território nacional, contando com mais de 152 lojas, um grande centro de distribuição em Paulínia, uma rede de logistica e um centro de suporte às lojas no Estado de São Paulo que presta assistência especializada para toda a rede.

Presente em várias cidades brasileiras, atende com cuidado especial mais de 550 mil clientes por mês!

Valorizamos a diversidade e acreditamos em ambientes inclusivos. Todas as pessoas, independentemente de gênero, raça, orientação sexual, idade ou deficiência, são bem-vindas para se candidatar.

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Realizar inspeções diárias, identificando e avaliando riscos à segurança do trabalho, buscando eliminá-los ou reduzí-los para a prevenção de acidentes;
  • Aplicar treinamentos normativos sobre segurança do trabalho para os colaboradores, incluindo NR-05, NR-06, NR-11, NR-18 e NR-35;
  • Analisar e realizar o controle da entrega de EPI’s, registrando e protocolando o recebimento, além de auditar a utilização e conduzir ações de conscientização;
  • Auxiliar no desenvolvimento e implementação de procedimentos de segurança do trabalho, buscando consolidar uma cultura de segurança efetiva;
  • Avaliar a execução de atividades de risco, garantindo que sejam realizadas de acordo com a legislação vigente e os procedimentos de segurança internos;
  • Controlar arquivos e processos relacionados ao setor, tais como: PGR, CIPA, PAE, brigada de incêndio, simulados de emergência, possíveis acidentes de trabalho, treinamentos, etc;
  • Garantir o cumprimento das normas regulamentadoras (NRs), em especial as que envolvem movimentação de cargas, operação de máquinas e trabalho em altura.

Requisitos:

  • Ensino Médio Completo;
  • Curso Técnico completo em Segurança do Trabalho (com registro ativo no MTE);
  • Experiência na área de Segurança do Trabalho (preferencialmente no setor de logística);
  • Pacote Office Intermediário ou Avançado;
  • Conhecimento das Normas Regulamentadoras, em especial, NR-01, NR-05, NR-06, NR-11 e NR-35;
  • Disponibilidade para atuar 100% presencial em Paulínia/SP.

Job Requirements

  • Proven experience in data engineering , ETL development , or data migration within a SaaS environment

  • Strong hands-on knowledge of SQL and experience working with relational databases
  • Ability to work with multiple data formats (e.g., CSV, structured/unstructured sources)
  • Strong analytical mindset with high attention to data accuracy and quality
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Knowledge of software development best practices, including version control and code reviews

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with GIS technologies and spatial data formats such as shapefiles

  • Experience building scalable data pipelines and automating complex workflows

title: Analista de Web Analytics Pleno
description:
Descrição da vaga

Aqui, você terá a oportunidade de acelerar ideias, desviar de obstáculos com leveza e manter o olhar lá na frente , sempre buscando ser um pouco melhor a cada dia. Valorizamos e impulsionamos cada talento, oferecendo um ambiente seguro e inclusivo, onde o crescimento profissional e pessoal são prioridades.

Somos CAR Group. Somos Santander. Somos Webmotors! E estamos prontos para pilotar essa transformação com você.

Vem com a gente fazer parte de algo grandioso!

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Quais serão as responsabilidades?

Como Analista de Web Analytics Pleno, você será responsável por apoiar iniciativas de mensuração e análise digital, contribuindo para a qualidade na coleta e interpretação de dados que sustentam decisões de negócio. No dia a dia, você irá:

  • Definir e acompanhar indicadores de performance (KPIs) e métricas relevantes para diferentes áreas de negócio, garantindo alinhamento com objetivos estratégicos.
  • Construir e manter relatórios e dashboards no Adobe Workspace, assegurando clareza, consistência e utilidade para stakeholders.
  • Realizar análises de desempenho digital , transformando dados em insights práticos para otimização de produtos e campanhas.
  • Produzir relatórios Adhoc , com análises quantitativas e qualitativas que apoiem recomendações de melhoria.
  • Participar do planejamento e execução de testes A/B e multivariados , contribuindo para a definição de hipóteses e avaliação de resultados.
  • Colaborar na documentação técnica de coleta de dados , apoiando a governança e padronização dos processos de Web Analytics.
  • Configurar e validar eventos, variáveis e dimensões no Adobe Launch e outras ferramentas de tagueamento, garantindo precisão na captura de dados.
  • Apoiar times internos e parceiros na adoção de boas práticas de mensuração digital e na evolução da maturidade analítica.

Requisitos e qualificações

O que esperamos que você tenha?

Buscamos um profissional com sólida experiência em Web Analytics e forte capacidade de liderança técnica. O perfil ideal deve contemplar:

  • Experiência em tagueamento de sites e aplicativos , com domínio das principais metodologias de coleta de dados e capacidade de realizar troubleshooting em cenários comuns.
  • Bom conhecimento em Adobe Analytics, Adobe Launch e Adobe Target , incluindo configuração, manutenção e integração entre plataformas, com apoio em projetos de evolução.
  • Vivência em Data Visualization , estruturando dashboards claros e objetivos que apoiem a tomada de decisão das áreas de negócio.
  • Conhecimento prático em linguagens de programação (JavaScript, HTML, CSS) e SQL , aplicados à manipulação de dados e integração de soluções analíticas.
  • Capacidade analítica e consultiva , colaborando com diferentes áreas na interpretação de dados e na adoção de boas práticas de mensuração digital.
  • Participação em projetos de mensuração digital , contribuindo para a implementação de frameworks de tagueamento, governança de dados e integração com ferramentas analíticas.

Informações adicionais

Acreditamos que a verdadeira transformação só acontece quando diferentes histórias, olhares e trajetórias se encontram. Por isso, valorizamos e promovemos um ambiente diverso, seguro e inclusivo, onde todas as pessoas possam ser quem são — com autonomia, respeito e pertencimento.

Nosso modelo de trabalho é híbrido , com três dias presenciais por semana na sede do Santander, na Vila Olímpia . Um espaço colaborativo, moderno e cheio de conexões — onde ideias ganham velocidade e pessoas impulsionam o futuro.
